title: Dust asbestos and silica collapse breathing plan
content: Collapsed buildings can create hazardous dust. The safest medical action is avoidance, wet dust control, respiratory protection if available, and symptom tracking.
steps: Keep children, elders, pregnant people, and lung disease away from dusty debris.
Do not dry sweep suspected hazardous dust.
Use appropriate mask/respirator if available and fitted; cloth is not equal protection.
Ventilate away from clean sleeping/food areas.
Escalate for breathing trouble, chest pain, persistent cough, wheeze, or eye injury.
